query: Apache Tomcat 9.0.97 Unauthenticated File Upload HTTP PUT arbitrary file write

sources.title: Apache Tomcat on Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
sources.snippet: Apache Tomcat: When running Apache Tomcat on Windows with HTTP PUTs enabled, it is possible to upload a JSP file to the server via a specially crafted request. This JSP could then be requested and any code it contained would be executed by the server. Required action: Apply updates per vendor instructions.
supports: CISA KEV identifies CVE-2017-12615 as exploited in the wild.

sources.title: CVE-2008-0457: NVD vulnerability record
sources.snippet: Unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the FileUpload class running on the Symantec LiveState Apache Tomcat server, as used by Symantec Backup Exec System Recovery Manager 7.0 and 7.0.1, allows remote attackers to upload and execute arbitrary JSP files via unknown vectors.
supports: NVD lists CVE-2008-0457 for a product matching 'Apache Tomcat'; version applicability and exploitation are unverified.

sources.title: CVE-2001-0829: NVD vulnerability record
sources.snippet: A cross-site scripting vulnerability in Apache Tomcat 3.2.1 allows a malicious webmaster to embed Javascript in a request for a .JSP file, which causes the Javascript to be inserted into an error message.
supports: NVD lists CVE-2001-0829 for a product matching 'Apache Tomcat'; version applicability and exploitation are unverified.

sources.title: CVE-2002-0493: NVD vulnerability record
sources.snippet: Apache Tomcat may be started without proper security settings if errors are encountered while reading the web.xml file, which could allow attackers to bypass intended restrictions.
supports: NVD lists CVE-2002-0493 for a product matching 'Apache Tomcat'; version applicability and exploitation are unverified.
